rv.q: Paramount’s production of Mean Girls the Musical proves to be a smart, engaging take on the material, carried by a committed cast and a creative team that understands how to translate the story’s humor and heart to the stage.
This production gives them plenty of reasons to stay: strong performances, energetic choreography, clever staging and a cast that understands the human being hiding beneath the stereotype.
This production of MEAN GIRLS is a winner.

This is a highly entertaining production with an exceptionally strong cast, two excellent leads, a standout comic performance from Veronica Garza and projections that give the familiar story a fresh visual identity.

Paramount’s production goes all out on the look and feel of Mean Girls and backed it up with all the bells and whistles of the theatrical elements that make this show feel like we’re at a Broadway level production.
If you have seen a production before, you want to catch this one to see how it really should be done!

cn.t: Paramount's production of Mean Girls earns strong praise for its vibrant staging and sharp performances, capturing the satirical edge beneath the pink spectacle while delivering Broadway-quality theatrical elements that resonate with both longtime fans and newcomers.
